author: Praxis IV
title: Idea 4: Angular de-duplication within kNN candidates (PCA60, k=50, cosine, binary)
abstract: Within each row’s top-(k+20) candidates, discard neighbors nearly collinear with closer ones (cosine > 0.995), then top-up by distance to k. Hypothesis: reduces redundant within-batch neighbors in dense cores without quotas/residualization.
